findings.title: Radar lacks sweep/contacts
findings.where: Arena and road screens, bottom left
findings.problem: Radar is a static black disc with no visible sweep or contact markers
findings.why: Players expect a radar to indicate threats, but static UI reduces immersion and trust in the instrument
findings.fix: Add a dynamic sweep line and visible contact markers to the radar UI

findings.title: Status text too small
findings.problem: Critical status text 'Not road-legal' is too small and hard to read
findings.why: Players need immediate visibility of car legality for gameplay flow, but small text causes missed info
findings.fix: Increase font size of 'Not road-legal' to minimum 16px with high contrast

findings.title: Weapon slots low contrast
findings.where: Constructor screen, left column under Weapon 1-10
findings.problem: Weapon slot status text '(empty)' has low contrast against dark background
findings.why: Players need to quickly identify empty weapon slots, but low contrast obscures status
findings.fix: Set '(empty)' text to white with 90% opacity for high contrast against dark background

findings.title: Banner text awkwardly split
findings.problem: Progress banner uses dashes to split text, causing awkward line breaks
findings.why: Text is hard to parse quickly, affecting readability at speed during gameplay
findings.fix: Replace dashes with vertical bars or reformat text into a single line with clear segmentation

findings.title: Tagline poor contrast
findings.where: Title screen, center below main title
findings.problem: Tagline text is too light against dark background, reducing legibility
findings.why: Key game information is not immediately visible, hindering first impression and clarity
findings.fix: Increase tagline font weight to bold and ensure 70% contrast against background
